data.description:
## Description

**What**: After Call 2 returns, compute proximity overlap between each new finding's cited_lines and every entry in prior_findings.json (overlap = same file AND line ranges intersect OR within ±5 lines). If overlap exists and reviewer declared NEW_INTRODUCED without escape_rationale, reject and re-dispatch Call 2 once with re-classify message. escape_rationale must structurally reference at least one token/line not in prior cited_lines AND not in proximity overlap region — orchestrator verifies syntactically. Same logic in CI with single re-dispatch cap.
**Why**: SC1 escape-hatch guard. Forces RESUSTAIN_OF when overlap exists; raises cost of bypassing arbitration. Structural validation prevents reviewer from rationalizing pro-forma escape text.
**Scope**:
  IN:
  - Proximity overlap helper computes file + ±5-line range intersection
  - Re-dispatch path issues a single Call 2 retry with explicit re-classify instruction
  - escape_rationale structural validator: syntactic check that referenced tokens are not in prior cited_lines or overlap region
  - CI dispatch implements same logic with single re-dispatch cap; emits ESCALATE_REVIEW: relation_misclassification_unresolved on second misclassification
  - Call 2 completeness check: missing finding IDs trigger one re-dispatch; persistently missing carry forward as NEW_INTRODUCED + call2_finding_drop_rate increment
  OUT:
  - Reviewer Call 1 / Call 2 wiring (S8)
  - Arbiter (S10)

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, the orchestrator rejects misclassified NEW_INTRODUCED findings on overlapping/proximate lines and re-dispatches Call 2; the structural escape_rationale validator runs without an LLM call
  ← Satisfies: "Stateful re-review with two-call reviewer architecture, orchestrator-side proximity-overlap verification, and severity-history telemetry"
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic

## Considerations

- [Reliability] Inverse RESUSTAIN_OF gaming (red team #2) addressed via implementation-plan check that prior_finding_id exists in prior_findings.json + proximity to new finding
- [Performance] Re-dispatch cap prevents unbounded API spend in CI

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As an orchestrator, I run proximity-overlap verification with structural escape_rationale validation and re-dispatch on misclassification
